prerequisite.reason: The original mixed-selector ampersand key produced Text but had Dynamic paired descriptors. A separately committed metadata-only successful-return fix restores nullable/nonnullable Text proofs without relaxing Dynamic group admission. Its four test functions are existing dependency regressions in this record, not four additional new Text tests.

contracts: Admission uses existing active paired group_types: at least one Text column plus current exact scalar/NULL families. Actual successful carriers are checked without conversion/provider activation; raw String bytes belong only to Text, while standard expression Error keeps its original validated strict-key path.

Qualified keys evaluate once and retain their complete cells. Checked source EOF and full per-column policy/completion cohorts precede every membership comparison; the whole strict partition finishes before any aggregate operand/state/provider work. No Text or partial-key fingerprint/stable-policy guess is used.

First encountered key spelling, raw representation, fixed scale, declaration and merged lineage remain original cells. NULL tuples, singleton unused-provider behavior, raw decode/provider priority and column short-circuiting use the existing authoritative comparer.

Count/key/scalar-only captures no source-row frames and allocates no row-assignment capacity. Operand-bearing HAVING or SELECT captures paid moved rows; a post-partition assignment sequence preserves original global input and written aggregate occurrence order.

HAVING active operands run only after partition; selected aggregate states/operands remain suppressed until their group passes. Count(*) result slots use checked group counts with full node identities. Key and aggregate operand policy cohorts stay separate.

Final retained GroupKeys avoid invented representative source rows. TOP retains later accepted eager final work; typed sink/query/source failures stop later groups/arms and owner restoration wraps capture, partition, replay and finish.

Live storage is O(retained key storage), including raw backing buffers outside active ranges, plus optional rows/assignments/states/candidates. Cumulative Bytes still charge per-input projected/key copies even when they drop. No complete source/named prefix cache, spill, snapshot fallback or constant-memory claim.

Existing exact-key and global/no-group paths retain prior charged allocation layouts and phases; the shared HAVING population adds only a stack predicate-count flag, false on the existing path. Date/float/GUID/Binary/Dynamic key profiles and inner stateful/set/ordering/join extensions are not admitted.
independent_controls: Final all-equal versus ordinal providers change actual early-row memberships and aggregate populations. Comparison traces prove every key membership precedes operand comparisons; independent reverse-ordinal operand cohorts are not overwritten by key policies.

Ordinal/case-equivalence/nullable spelling classes and Text tuples with every existing exact family retain first representatives across all four preparation/execution profile combinations and derived aliases.

Raw odd/unpaired singleton observers, strict final publication, repeated-key missing-provider/decode priorities, explicit UTF16 support, Error/raw pair refusals and NULL short-circuit cases are pinned first against ordinary buffered capabilities.

A generated 100,003-row source groups seventeen independently modeled categories under explicit budgets with Label-only source projection and no buffered fallback. This establishes snapshot avoidance and finite bounded work, not retained-live-memory measurement.

A private allocation contract passes selected three-field inner rows including a 4 KiB payload, then proves Count/key-only candidates contain no source row and partition assignment length/capacity remain zero; selected or HAVING operands retain original rows. A second probe verifies wrong successful Date/Float/Int values under Text descriptors fail while standard Error data remains accepted.

Final-group prefix overflow, HAVING false/NULL projection suppression, failed EOF before membership, swallowed immediate callback errors, late key error before selected errors, original typed sink stops, quotas, every observed cancellation checkpoint and prepared reuse are covered.
Existing Count under 8 KiB, all current exact/fixed/grouped/HAVING/pipeline services, and buffered key/raw/policy/crosstab/UNION/alias metadata regressions remain green.
